faq_heading: Homes near Johnston Heights Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Johnston Heights Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Johnston Heights Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Johnston Heights Secondary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Johnston Heights Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 317 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,200,000, townhomes $710,000, condos $495,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Johnston Heights Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Johnston Heights Secondary the median was 29 days on the market, closing at 96.8% of the list price, with 7% of sales above the list price for the 317 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Johnston Heights Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Mountainview Montessori (0.3 km south-west), William F. Davidson Elementary (0.4 km east) and Bonaccord Elementary (0.8 km west).

Johnston Heights Secondary is a secondary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 15350 99 Ave. It teaches grades 8 to 12. Programs listed: IB Middle Years Programme; IB Diploma Programme.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Johnston Heights Secondary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 2 km of the school.
How the Johnston Heights Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Johnston Heights Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Johnston Heights Secondary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 317 homes sold within 2 km of Johnston Heights Secondary: 93 houses, 112 townhomes and 109 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $710,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Johnston Heights Secondary

29 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Johnston Heights Secondary in a straight line (20 elementary, 7 secondary, 2 other; 3 independent). The closest is Mountainview Montessori, 0.3 km away, and the farthest on this list is SAIL Secondary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is North Surrey Secondary (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is St Matthew's Elementary (2.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is North Surrey Secondary (1.3 km). Other secondary schools close by: North Surrey Secondary (1.3 km south-east), Guildford Park Secondary (2.2 km north-west), Fraser Heights Secondary (2.3 km north-east), Holy Cross Regional High School (2.6 km south-east), SAIL Secondary (2.9 km south-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is North Surrey Secondary, 1.3 km south-east of Johnston Heights Secondary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Johnston Heights Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Johnston Heights Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Johnston Heights Secondary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median townhome within 2 km of Johnston Heights Secondary was $710,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at North Surrey Secondary, the nearest other secondary school, 1.3 km south-east of Johnston Heights Secondary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
